ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity (white) central surface area versus 35% low-intensity (black/dark grey) peripheral and trailing edge regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white blobs dominate the center of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is concentrated in a continuous band along the trailing edge and outer margins, featuring vertical 'streak' patterns extending toward the center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 40 degrees and a significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels. Notable jagged peaks located at the distal tips and proximal to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges exhibit a slight convex curve, while the leading edges maintain a smooth, pronounced convexity toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, high-contrast textured bumps concentrated on the distal-most tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple low-intensity vertical linear streaks visible on the trailing edge of both lobes; a singular diagonal linear mark is visible on the upper quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the outer distal tips creating irregular physical protrusions; small asymmetric notch visible on the right lobe trailing edge approximately 15% distance from the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'dripping' pigment pattern where low-intensity pixels bleed into the high-intensity central region along the entirety of the trailing edge.
